about: Screenshots of the real app that the guide shows. apps/desktop/scripts/docs-shots.mjs makes every entry not marked todo; a todo entry needs a running agent or a second device and is captured by hand or by demo-media. Files land as images/app/<name>.<mode>.webp.
before: Redirect keeps the query || Test covers it
Add a dark theme to the settings page

shots.name: windows-view
shots.alt: The Windows view: one tile fills the window, with a tab for each tile across the top and the Layers panel on the left.

shots.name: canvas
shots.alt: The canvas: the Layers panel on the left lists the project and its tiles, the toolbar sits on top, and the project's frame holds a terminal tile.
shots.why: The canvas fits to its frame, not its tiles, so a headless run shows the tiles too small; capture with demo-media or fix the framing in the runner.

shots.name: issues-board
shots.alt: The Issues tile: a board with a column per state and a card for each issue.

shots.name: new-machine
shots.alt: The New machine dialog: the ssh address to reach, and the button that checks it.

shots.name: settings-api-access
shots.alt: Settings → API access, with New token at the top and the list of tokens below.

shots.name: settings-plugins
shots.alt: Settings → Plugins: the installed agents, views, widgets and tools, each with its switch.

shots.name: settings-notifications
shots.alt: Settings → Notifications: the switch, and which events notify you: Needs you, Finished, Failed.

shots.name: settings-shortcuts
shots.alt: Settings → Shortcuts: the keys that work anywhere, and the keys that work on the canvas.

shots.name: settings-connect
shots.alt: Settings → Connect: your devices, the people in this workspace, and the button that makes an invite.

shots.name: settings-servers
shots.alt: Settings → Servers: the network this computer uses, and Set up my server with an agent.

shots.name: settings-appearance
shots.alt: Settings → Appearance: theme, wallpaper and glass.

shots.name: canvas-annotated
shots.alt: The canvas with numbered callouts: 1 frame, 2 tile, 3 Layers panel, 4 bell, 5 toolbar.
shots.why: Callouts are an HTML overlay on the canvas shot, drawn on the page; the shot needs agents in the frame.

shots.name: agent-states-tiles
shots.alt: Three agent tiles: one working, one idle, one amber because it needs you.
shots.why: Needs real agents (demo-media stand-ins).

shots.name: first-agent-needs-you
shots.alt: The claude tile's header is amber, and the bell in the Layers panel shows 1: the agent is asking to create a file.
shots.why: Needs a real agent asking a permission question (a demo-media story beat).

shots.name: invite-dialog
shots.alt: The invite: a QR code, six words and Copy the link.
shots.why: Needs a network the computer is enrolled in.

shots.name: three-word-match
shots.alt: The same three words on the computer and on the phone, with It's me — the words match.
shots.why: Needs a second device pairing.

shots.name: settings-agent-page
shots.alt: An agent's page in Settings → Plugins: Make default, its settings, and Read me.
shots.why: Needs an agent installed from HiveHub in the run's profile.

shots.name: review-comment-loop
shots.alt: A line comment in Changes, and the agent fixing it.
shots.why: A loop video; needs a real agent (demo-media).

shots.name: guest-faces-loop
shots.alt: A guest's face top right, their named pointer, and Ask for keyboard → Give.
shots.why: A loop video; needs a second person joined.

shots.name: bell-and-amber-tile
shots.alt: The bell in the Layers panel shows 1 and the agent's tile is amber: it is waiting on a permission question.
shots.why: Needs a real agent asking a permission question.

shots.name: worktree-menu
shots.alt: A frame's ⋯ menu open on Worktree, offering Create new worktree based on main.
shots.why: Menu interaction on a git frame; add a click step.

shots.name: code-tile-changes
shots.alt: The Code tile on Changes, with a line comment and Send review to Claude.
shots.why: Needs an agent's edit and a comment.

shots.name: plan-review-tile
shots.alt: The Plan review tile with Approve plan and Request changes.
shots.why: Needs a tile id for hive ctl open-review --tile.

shots.name: sleep-menu
shots.alt: A Layers row's ⋮ menu: Pin, Mark as unread, Snooze, Put to sleep.
shots.why: Needs an agent row.

shots.name: plugins-hivehub-tab
shots.alt: Settings → Plugins on the HiveHub tab, listing plugins to install.
shots.why: Needs a click on the HiveHub tab; add a click step.

shots.name: widgets-counter
shots.alt: The counter widget from the tutorial, pressed three times.
shots.why: Needs hive plugins new widget counter built in the run.

shots.name: view-pulse
shots.alt: The Pulse starter view showing four tiles, one waiting.
shots.why: Needs the starter view built and agents.

shots.name: tool-switch
shots.alt: A tool's page in Settings → Plugins with its switch off.
shots.why: Needs @dip497/worktrees installed in the run's profile.

shots.name: tool-branch-tile
shots.alt: The starter tool's tile showing the git branch.
shots.why: Needs hive plugins new tool built in the run.

shots.name: appearance-glass
shots.alt: The canvas and Layers panel with a wallpaper and glass panels on.
shots.why: Needs a wallpaper image in the run.

shots.name: machines-pane
shots.alt: The Machines pane: one machine online, one grey asking you to sign in.
shots.why: Needs two saved machines.

shots.name: connect-your-devices
shots.alt: Your devices: a host, a computer and a phone, each with Unpair.
shots.why: Needs paired devices.

shots.name: multiplayer-keyboard
shots.alt: A guest asks for the keyboard; the holder sees Give and Not now.
shots.why: Needs a second person.

shots.name: host-pair-terminal
shots.alt: hive host pair prints six words, a link and a QR code.
shots.why: Needs a host on a network.

shots.name: browser-tab-settings
shots.alt: Settings → In a browser with Serve the app to a browser on, its link and Open.
shots.why: Needs the switch turned on in the run; add a step.

shots.name: update-restart
shots.alt: The toolbar showing Update available, then Restart to finish.
shots.why: Needs a newer release than the running app.

shots.name: first-start-agents-added
shots.alt: The notice listing the agents Hivemind added on first start.
shots.why: Needs agent programs on PATH in a fresh profile.

shots.name: asleep-tile
shots.alt: A sleeping agent's tile with its Resume button.
shots.why: Needs an agent put to sleep.
